title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the ground state energy must be correctly stated as E = hbar omega + (alpha_0 alpha) / (alpha_0^2 + 2beta)^(1/2).

title: Perturbation Approach
description: Important Criteria: The use of perturbation theory to calculate the first-order energy correction must be clearly indicated.

title: Wave Function Form
description: Important Criteria: The correct form of the unperturbed wave function for two identical bosons must be provided.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The double integral setup for calculating the first-order energy correction must be correctly established.

title: Variable Transformation
description: Optional Criteria: The transformation of variables used to simplify the integration should be mentioned.

title: Alpha Parameter Usage
description: Optional Criteria: The role of the interaction strength parameter alpha in the energy correction should be discussed.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expression will lead to a deduction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failure to maintain consistent units throughout the calculations will result in a deduction.
